**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — Rule T4C, Termination for convenience**

Section 12.3 gives AbbVie a clean termination-for-convenience right ("for any or no reason") on 90 days' notice, exercisable in whole or country-by-country, with no early-termination fee or penalty. Harpoon has no convenience right — its termination rights are confined to our uncured material breach (§12.2) and insolvency (§12.4), which is better than the fallback (which would allow Vendor convenience termination at end of term on 90 days' notice).

Noted but not flagged: the notice period is 90 days rather than our preferred 30, and there is no express pro-rata refund mechanic (of limited relevance in a milestone/royalty structure). No redline proposed.
